title: Heat-induced mutator: DNA repair polymerase Polλ shapes mutation under heat
content: I hope my colleagues are not reading this because I am going to tell you my secret. I accidentally left my DNA samples at 37 °C overnight recently. I had to throw them away because I needed undamaged DNA. What an elementary mistake! We all know that heat is bad for DNA, but look out from your window: DNA is exposed to environmental heat in plants.
